claim: arch_plan_command.md's Exit Codes section: "One condition warns and does not fail: a resolved profile whose plan-relevant list is empty. Stderr says that no node type produces tasks, so the changeset carries no create op and an adapter run creates none; the run then proceeds as usual" — echoed in flow_plan.md's Error Paths as "a warning on stderr that no node type produces tasks and an adapter run would create none".
authoritative_source: flow_plan.md step 5 ("Order"): TopologicalSorter partitions create actions into "the proposal epic, then one layer per kind in the profile's plan-relevant order ..., then cleanups" — the epic and cleanup layers are not gated by the plan-relevant list, only the middle layers are. module.json's node-type gate table (de42d9efa750 / arch_action_classifier.md "Node-Type Gate") applies only to unmatched added/modified changes; a removed node's orphaned pairing (8987ef169e48, "Classify cleanup actions for removed nodes") and the proposal epic (13296c25e250, "Parent resolution from mapping store") are resolved independently of that gate.
evidence: With an empty plan-relevant list: (1) a registration with no epic pairing in the fold still yields a proposal-epic create — TestPlanCommand_S4_EmptyDiff_SynthesizesEpicWhenUnregisteredInFold already exercises this path for the general (non-empty-list) case, and nothing in ActionClassifier's node-type gate or TopologicalSorter's layering touches epic resolution; and (2) a removed node whose task the task-state artifact doesn't list still yields a cleanup create, since the node-type gate the plan-relevant list drives applies only to the unmatched (added/modified) path, never to orphaned (removed) pairings. Both therefore survive an empty plan-relevant list, directly contradicting the leaf's "the changeset carries no create op" / "an adapter run creates none" claim. Neither leaf states whether that claim is meant to hold only for the plan-relevant node types (component/data_flow/test_section) and silently exclude the epic/cleanup layers, or whether it is a stronger promise the current layering already violates.
proposed_fix: Reword the Exit Codes/Error Paths sentence to state only what plan-relevant emptiness actually guarantees — no create op for a plan-relevant node type — and drop the "the changeset carries no create op" / "an adapter run creates none" clause, or explicitly except the epic and cleanup layers (abfb10394fdd's layering already treats them as exempt from the plan-relevant order by construction).
